decisions.reason: The coolant pressure booster is core to the firm's coolant-management systems and cheap to keep, and two years on the market are still too few to resolve its value, so the option stays open.
The cleaning centrifuge complements the firm's filtration offering at low holding cost, and nothing yet shows its value will not be realized, so abandoning it now would be premature.
Coolant nozzles are a low-cost accessory line that supports system sales, so keeping the option costs very little.
Scraper belt chip conveyors are a staple with steady demand from metalworking customers, and the evidence supports further commitment rather than abandonment.
The magnetic belt conveyor shares the established conveyor platform, so keeping it costs little while its prospects keep unfolding.
Hinged belt chip conveyors are a core product for machine tool users and support the modular offering at minimal cost.
